title: Machine Learning Engineer, Core Experimentation
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Statsig team within OpenAI builds the experimentation, feature rollout, dynamic configuration, and analytics systems that help OpenAI ship products with speed, safety, and evidence. Our work sits on the critical path for how product, engineering, research, and go-to-market teams learn from real-world usage and make high-confidence decisions.

Statsig began as an independent company focused on helping builders move faster through trustworthy experimentation and feature management. After Statsig joined OpenAI, the team began the next chapter: bringing that deep product expertise, customer intuition, and mature platform infrastructure into OpenAI as the experimentation and rollout platform for every product we ship.

Today, we support teams across ChatGPT, Codex, model measurement, consumer experiences, business subscriptions, developer products, and the shared infrastructure that connects them. These teams rely on Statsig to safely introduce new capabilities, compare product and model behavior, measure impact, and roll changes forward or back with confidence.

We are at a defining moment in the platform journey. OpenAI has the data, product surface area, and pace of innovation to learn faster than almost any organization in the world, but that potential only becomes real if teams can experiment responsibly, measure clearly, and roll out changes safely.

We are evolving experimentation systems to help teams learn from product behavior and make better evidence-based decisions.

Based out of OpenAI’s Bellevue office, we are a close-knit team that values in-person collaboration, urgency, craft, and impact. We build for other builders, and the best version of this team is one where every OpenAI product team can move faster because the experimentation and rollout layer is dependable, fast, and easy to use.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to lead the technical direction for ML-powered experimentation and insights capabilities. You will build production systems that learn from privacy-protected product and experimentation data to generate evidence-backed insights and support decision-making, and help teams decide which ideas are worth testing live.

This is an end-to-end, 0-to-1 role. You will work across ML modeling, retrieval and LLM systems, statistical methods, simulation, data and training pipelines, backend services, and user- and agent-facing product experiences. The hard part is not merely producing a plausible answer. It is making each insight and prediction traceable, calibrated, useful, and safe enough to influence real product decisions.

Live experiments remain the source of causal validation. You will design systems that make uncertainty explicit, backtest against historical outcomes, compare predictions with online results, learn from misses, and abstain when the evidence is weak. You will preserve clear review, permission, and approval boundaries as automation becomes more powerful.

You will collaborate closely with teams building ChatGPT, Codex, model measurement workflows, consumer products, Growth, business subscription experiences, developer products, and shared infrastructure. You will turn their most important learning and decision problems into general platform capabilities that can support the full company.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Set and execute the technical roadmap for Generative Insights and Predictive Experimentation, from early prototypes through production adoption.

- Build cross-experiment learning systems that retrieve and synthesize historical experiments, detect recurring effects and segment behavior, reanalyze prior results when data or methods improve, and generate hypotheses with clear evidence and provenance.

- Develop predictive models and simulation workflows, including simulation-based evaluation approaches, to estimate likely impact, affected segments, regression risk, and uncertainty before a full live experiment.

description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

title: Engineering Manager - Unified Platform
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

The Unified Privacy Platform team’s mission is to earn the trust of every DoorDash user by upholding their right to privacy, consent, and transparency. We are building a common privacy foundation across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo so Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants can understand how their data is used, control their choices, and exercise their privacy rights through simple, consistent experiences.

Our work is organized around three connected pillars: the Privacy Center, a unified user-facing destination for privacy controls and rights; the Unified Privacy Platform, which captures and enforces consent, policy, jurisdictional requirements, and privacy actions; and Privacy Operations and Intelligence, which gives Legal, Support, Privacy, and engineering operators the workflows, diagnostics, audit history, and automation needed to resolve privacy work safely and efficiently. 

Together, these capabilities turn fragmented, one-off compliance work into reusable platform primitives that can support new products, brands, and emerging regulations.

About the Role

DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Unified Privacy Platform team. You will lead a team of backend and platform engineers responsible for the next generation of privacy and consent infrastructure, including the Privacy Center, the User Consent Platform, privacy-policy decisioning, self-service data-rights experiences, and the operational tooling required to manage privacy cases at global scale.

As the Engineering Manager, you will own and execute a multi-year vision for privacy at DoorDash. You will balance legal and regulatory correctness, user trust, security, reliability, and developer velocity while building systems that work consistently across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. You will be a strategic partner to Product, Legal, Security, Data Governance, Marketing and Communications, and engineering leadership, establishing clear ownership boundaries and turning complex privacy requirements into scalable, self-service capabilities.

 

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Lead and mentor a high-performing team of backend and platform engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, privacy by design, operational excellence, and thoughtful cross-functional partnership

• Drive the technical strategy across the Privacy Center, the Unified Privacy Platform, and Privacy Operations and Intelligence

• Build the cross-brand User Consent Platform, including canonical consent state, policy and configuration management, consent SDKs, audit history, and consistent enforcement across products and jurisdictions

• Deliver simple, self-service experiences for consent and communication preferences, Right to be Forgotten (RTF), Right to Information (RTI), and Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs)

• Turn emerging privacy and regulatory requirements into standardized platform capabilities instead of one-off product implementations

• Lead the migration from fragmented legacy consent systems to a single source of truth across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, while managing compatibility and safe deprecation

• Define clear contracts with data-governance fulfillment systems and downstream product and storage te

Kaluza https://www.kaluza.com/ is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

Kaluza runs the billing and payments engine behind some of the world's biggest energy retailers. This role builds and evolves the platform other engineering teams build on top of: the shared APIs, integration patterns, and technical standards that let billing and payments capability get built once and reused everywhere, instead of rebuilt separately for every new market or client relationship.

That matters because of where Kaluza is headed: as we grow into new markets and take on more of the world's largest energy retailers as clients, having a consistent, well-designed API platform is what lets new capability get adopted quickly and safely across every team that needs it, rather than each team solving integration and standards problems on its own. Getting this right directly shapes how fast Kaluza can extend billing and payments capability to new markets and clients.

We're also in the middle of reorganising how this part of the business works, moving toward one shared global core that every market configures rather than rebuilds. This role's remit, API platform and standards, is one of the technical foundations that shift depends on. Responsibilities include:

- You'll mentor and upskill engineers beyond your immediate team, contributing to a wider learning culture.

title: Legal Operations Manager
description:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is seeking an experienced Legal Operations Manager to lead the end-to-end customer contracting process and oversee the daily operations of the Contract Operations function.

This role is responsible for ensuring customer contracts move efficiently through review, approval, execution, and operational handoff while maintaining compliance with established contracting processes and providing visibility throughout the contract lifecycle. The Contract Operations Manager will drive process improvements, optimize CLM and Salesforce workflows. This position operates as part of the Legal Department and partners closely with Sales, Finance, Service Delivery, Security, and Customer Success.

The ideal candidate combines strong contract management experience with a process improvement mindset and the ability to build scalable, efficient contracting operations.

How You Will Make An Impact

Contract Lifecycle Management

• Own the end-to-end lifecycle for customer contracts, including SOWs, Change Orders, MSAs, service agreements, amendments, renewals, and related commercial documents.

• Oversee contract intake, review, approvals, redline coordination, execution, retention, and archival.

• Ensure contractual documentation is complete, properly approved, and consistent with established contracting standards and processes.

• Coordinate effective handoff of executed contracts to downstream business teams.

Contract Operations & Process Improvement

• Reviewing Statements of Work and related commercial documentation for completeness, consistency, operational readiness, and compliance with approved contracting standards prior to execution.

• Continuously evaluate and improve contracting workflows and partner with Legal, Sales, Service Delivery and other stakeholders to recommend and implement process improvements.

• Identify process bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions that improve efficiency, visibility, and cycle times.

• Drive automation initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve stakeholder experience.

• Establish and maintain service-level expectations and operational controls.

Governance & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and Legal, coordinating contract reviews, issue identification, risk escalation, and resolution of contractual matters.

• Review and coordinate negotiation of customer MSAs, SOWs, amendments, and other commercial agreements, including identification and escalation of contractual, operational, and commercial risks in accordance with established approval processes and contracting guidelines.

• Support approval matrices, playbooks, templates, and contracting standards.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for contract process guidance and issue resolution.

• Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Service Delivery, Security, and Customer Success to ensure smooth contract execution and operational readiness.

Systems & Reporting

• Serve as the business owner for contract lifecycle management processes and related systems.

• Manage and optimize contract workflows within CLM and Salesforce platforms.

• Maintain contract repositories, reporting, documentation standards, and data integrity.

• Develop reporting that identifies bottlenecks and process inefficiencies across the contracting lifecycle.

Team Leadership

• Lead and develop the Contract Operations team.

• Establish team priorities, workload management practices, and performance expectations.

• Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service.

What You Will Bring To The Table

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Contract Operations, Contract Management, Contract Administration, Legal Operations, or a related field.

• Experience supporting technology services, managed services, outsourcing, cloud, cybersecurity, professional services, or consulting agreements.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Frankfurt
description:
Du hast noch nie im Vertrieb gearbeitet, würdest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlangen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei uns lernst du Vertrieb von Grund auf und baust dir dein eigenes Netzwerk in deiner Region auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Senior Software Engineer II - Agentic Intelligence
description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!

If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb .io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:
AI agents at Honeycomb investigate, reason, and act on real observability data. They live in Canvas: the agentic workspace where engineers go to understand their systems.
The Agentic Intelligence team has shipped Canvas, the Honeycomb MCP server, and the Canvas Agent and Canvas Skills surfaces. What we're looking for today is someone who brings deep agent expertise and uses it to expand what the team can build: new agents, new surface area in Canvas, memory, spatial awareness, improved performance on our Bedrock loop.
Honeycomb 's data store is fast and accepts high cardinality data; that's what makes agents built on top of it different from anything built on a conventional observability backend. This role is about taking advantage of that building agents that can do things no other observability product can do because the underlying data makes it possible.
Some of this work will start as a prototype. The expectation is that the code makes it through the full arc, from the rough first version through to something that holds up in production.
What you'll do

•
Design and deliver production-grade agents. Build agents that investigate, reason, and act on live observability data inside Canvas. These agents must be trustworthy to engineers in high pressure situations, including mid-incident. Take one from rough first version to something that holds up under production traffic.

•
Own the agent work; support the whole product. Scope, build, ship, and maintain the agents including the evals that tell you whether they got better or are just different. This role is agent-focused and also includes some fullstack development.

•
Build agents only Honeycomb can build. Use a data store that returns high-cardinality queries in seconds to reason over signal a conventional backend can't serve at this fidelity correlating across services, drilling into a single trace, comparing before and after a deploy.

•
Extend the surface, and decide what's next. Ship new capability into Canvas, the MCP server, and Canvas Skills memory, spatial awareness, a faster Bedrock loop and make the case for what comes after with working code. Distinguish hype from signal in a field with plenty of both.

•
Define what "good" means for agents here. Set the bar: measurable against real evals, maintainable, and honest about their limits.

Multiple agents collaborating on one shared Canvas investigation each claiming a hypothesis, publishing findings, and narrowing the search space for the others so it resolves faster (blog).

title: Lead VHA Contract Coder
description:
Job Summary
Job Summary
Lead VHA Contract Coder
Location: Remote
Serves as working lead responsible for outpatient and/or inpatient facility coding, audits, and coding team oversight in support of the VA Portland Health Care System (VAPORHCS). This position is part-time with flexible hours, ideal for a credentialed VHA coder seeking supplemental work.
Primary Responsibilities

• Perform outpatient and/or inpatient facility coding including ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT/HCPCS, DRG, and E&M for all encounters assigned by VAPORHCS

• Access and review health record documentation in VA's VistA/CPRS system; enter codes into the approved coding application

• Apply modifiers, CCI bundling guidelines, and Reason Not Billable (RNB) designations as appropriate

• Code all standard cases within 7 calendar days of receipt/discharge; priority cases within one business day

• Clarify conflicting, ambiguous, or nonspecific documentation; consult VHA coding guidance as appropriate.

• Comply with all HIPAA, VA/VHA privacy, security, and records management directives, and complete all required VA training prior to system access and annually thereafter

• Comply with AHIMA Standards of Ethical Coding

• Conduct coding audits covering not less than 5% of coded services; provide written feedback to team members, track quality trends, and report metrics to Arrow ARC PM on a weekly cadence

• Ensure team coding production meets contract and program office standards, including a minimum of 70 outpatient or 13 inpatient encounters per coder per 8-hour day, and a 95% accuracy rate per HIMS program office requirements

• Serve as primary point of contact for contract team coding questions and VA coding-related inquiries, including documentation clarification, VHA policy, and contract compliance matters

• Mentor and support coders transitioning into VA/VHA coding environments; assist with onboarding and ongoing education as needed

• Participate in VA-directed coding reviews, pre-bill re-reviews, or RAC/MAC audits as applicable

Minimum Qualifications

• Active coding credential from AHIMA (RHIA, RHIT, CCS, or CCS-P) or AAPC (CPC or CPC-H); credential must be maintained for the duration of the contract

• Proficiency with ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT/HCPCS, DRG assignment, and E&M guidelines

• Experience working within VA systems (e.g., VistA/CPRS, VIRR) and complying with HIPAA/VA directives

• Minimum 3 years of VHA facility coding experience, including current or recent experience (within the past 12 months) in a lead, supervisory, or senior coding role

• Experience conducting coding audits and delivering feedback

• Experience mentoring or training other coders

Desired Qualifications

• Experience developing or delivering coding education or training materials for team members or peers

• 5+ years of VHA facility coding experience, including lead or supervisory responsibility

title: Senior Finance Manager
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Finance Manager within our Business Unit FP&A team, you’ll play a key role in driving financial planning, forecasting, and strategic decision-making for Everpure’s subscription business. In this highly visible individual contributor role, you’ll own global top-line forecasting and financial modeling while partnering closely with Business Unit, Product, GTM, Operations, and Accounting leaders to understand performance and guide business decisions.

You’ll combine deep financial expertise with a strong understanding of subscription business models to translate complex data into clear insights, strengthen how we forecast and measure the business, and help leaders make informed decisions as Everpure continues to scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own Global Subscription Forecasting & Financial Modeling: Lead global top-line forecasting across pipeline, bookings, revenue, and margin, while developing and maintaining P&L and capex models. Partner closely with Accounting to ensure operational forecasts align with reported financial results.

• Turn Business Performance Into Strategic Insights: Analyze key subscription metrics including ARR, bookings, retention, churn, expansion, and gross margin. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear insights, compelling visuals, and executive-level narratives that inform business decisions.

• Serve as a Strategic Finance Partner: Partner with Business Unit, Product, GTM, Pricing, Operations, and Accounting leaders to evaluate business performance, strategic initiatives, pricing strategies, and investment opportunities. Support monthly business reviews, quarterly forecasts, annual planning, and long-range planning processes.

• Build Scalable FP&A Tools & Reporting: Design and automate forecasting, reporting, and analytical processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and accuracy. Develop dashboards and self-service reporting capabilities, partnering with Data Engineering and Business Systems teams to strengthen data quality and reporting infrastructure.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Significant experience supporting a subscription, SaaS, recurring revenue, or consumption-based business, with a strong understanding of metrics such as ARR, bookings, revenue, retention, churn, expansion, and gross margin.

• Advanced financial analysis and modeling skills, including expertise in Excel and experience developing and maintaining complex P&L, forecasting, and investment models.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial and operational data into clear business insights, executive-ready presentations, and actionable recommendations.

Nearly 2 billion Muslims have never heard the saving message of Jesus Christ . At Frontiers , we believe God is calling His Church to change that. We partner with local churches to send workers to the Muslim world-workers who make disciples and plant churches where the Gospel has never been heard.

Empower. Partner. Sustain

• Collaborate with the FieldPrep department to provide resources for Candidate School as needed.

• A personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a heart for missions

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills-able to encourage, motivate, and coach.

• Cross-cultural ministry experience.

• Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple relationships and responsibilities.

As our GTM Talent Partner, you'll own hiring across a broad commercial area of Checkatrade, partnering closely with our leaders to find the people who'll help us get there.

We're a lean, hands-on Talent team, so this is much bigger than picking up reqs. You'll properly own your space: understanding the business, challenging what we actually need, using data to influence decisions and making our hiring and processes better as you go.

THE JOB, UNFILTERED:

- Own end-to-end hiring across our GTM organisation, with a particular focus across Sales, Account Management, Revenue and Commercial Operations.

- Get properly under the skin of the areas you support: how they work, how they make money, what they're trying to achieve and the talent they need to get there.

- Run multiple searches at once without losing pace, quality or candidate experience.

- Spot things that aren't working and help us fix them. You'll have space to improve processes, test new tools and challenge the way we've always done things.

- Get involved in wider TA projects across data, automation, tooling, employer brand and candidate experience.

- Be part of the wider People team, working closely with People Partners and other teams rather than operating in a TA bubble.

Basically, you'll hire great people, but you'll also help us build a better Talent function while you're doing it.

THE FIT:

You'll ideally bring:

- Strong in-house Talent experience within a fast-moving tech or high-growth environment.

- Solid GTM/commercial hiring experience, particularly across Sales, Account Management, Revenue or Commercial Operations.

- Experience working in a lean TA environment where you've owned hiring end-to-end and contributed beyond your individual reqs.

- A genuinely data-led approach. You can use hiring metrics, pipeline data and market insight to diagnose a problem, tell a clear story and influence a decision.

- Strong sourcing skills and the confidence to proactively find great passive talent rather than relying on inbound applications.

- Experience managing multiple priorities in an environment where things move quickly and the brief isn't always perfectly formed.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance

- Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback

- Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles

- Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements

- Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

- Strong fundamentals in control theory, with depth in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems

- Practical experience developing, tuning and validating control or motion systems on real world physical systems

- Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++

- Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software

- Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware

- Applied experience with model predictive control, trajectory optimization, motion planning etc.

- Direct experience with mobile robotics or autonomous vehicle systems

- Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls

- Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)

- Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components

-

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision

Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews , we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role - especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews - but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As Associate General Counsel, Product & Regulatory, you'll own how legal and regulatory judgement shows up inside Mews ' product and fintech work, leading a specialist pod of counsel and paralegals and reporting to the Chief Legal Officer. Mews builds tightly integrated SaaS and fintech products, and the hard questions (money transmission, e-money, embedded finance, partner-bank and BaaS models, cross-border operating decisions) need someone who helps product teams work through them in practice, not from a distance. This is a chance to set the bar for how a scaling hospitality-fintech platform builds regulated products responsibly and at pace.
You'll be embedded with Product and Engineering as a genuine product counsel and builder, surfacing and triaging legal and regulatory issues across the design and release lifecycle rather than reviewing work once it's done. You'll own the Product & Regulatory legal remit end to end: setting priorities and the quality bar, deciding what the pod handles directly, what gets standardised, and what gets escalated, and building and managing an appropriately sized team as the work grows. You'll act as the senior legal point person for product-related regulatory matters across the business.
Mews operates in regulated environments, which means product decisions carry real legal and regulatory weight, from AML, BSA, KYC and KYB obligations through to supervisory expectations, audits and market entry. The teams building these products need legal support that moves at their pace and helps them make sound decisions early, with repeatable operating discipline around them. Getting this right is what lets Mews scale regulated and non-regulated products confidently.
What you would do

• Own the Product & Regulatory legal remit across Mews ' SaaS and fintech environment, setting priorities, operating norms and the quality bar for legal support to Product and Engineering.

• Embed with Product and Engineering as a hands-on product counsel, surfacing legal, regulatory and commercial trade-offs early and resolving them pragmatically across the release lifecycle.

• Provide senior legal guidance on regulated product design, launch and scaling, including payments, embedded finance, money transmission, partner-bank and BaaS models, and cross-border propositions.

• Build and manage a small specialist pod of counsel and paralegals, coaching them into strong product partners and building the playbooks, templates and working norms that let teams move faster without adding risk.

• Use AI to reshape how legal support is delivered into product development, improving speed, quality and consistency across the pod.

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role that means going beyond using AI for your own drafting and analysis. You'll redesign how the pod delivers legal support to product, using AI across intake, issue-spotting, comparison and first-draft playbooks; build approaches the rest of the team can follow, including prompt quality and review discipline; and apply strong legal judgement a

title: Strategic Advisor (Consultant), Department of State
description:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

About the Position
Dexis seeks a highly experienced Strategic Advisor Consultant to support business development activities relating to Department of State humanitarian assistance programs. The Advisor will play a critical role in Dexis’ strategic positioning and in identifying and preparing winning solutions for relevant business opportunities. Working closely with the Federal Civilian Account business development team, the Advisor will be responsible for refining our understanding of the current and evolving client landscape, validating opportunity parameters, and facilitating strategic introductions to key stakeholders across opportunities.
This is a 1099 consultant position. It will be based remotely in the continental United States.
Responsibilities

• Provide current strategic insight into the evolving needs and priorities, structure, and decision-making processes within the Department of State’s Bureau of Disaster and Humanitarian Response.

• Advise Dexis leadership on strategies for market positioning and client engagement specific to humanitarian assistance programming.

• Identify and facilitate introductions with relevant stakeholders throughout the capture and bid process.

• Identify opportunities aligned with Dexis’ corporate capabilities and growth objectives, provide strategic guidance and support on bid capture, and help prepare winning proposal.

• Validate strategic direction, programmatic objectives, potential scope, and customer needs and expectations for specific opportunities identified.

• Participate in periodic strategy sessions and serve as a trusted advisor throughout the pre-solicitation, capture, and bid phases.

Qualifications

• Minimum 10 years of experience supporting U.S. Government programs

• Prior experience with USAID's Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance (BHA), the Department of State's Bureau for Population, Refugees, and Migration (PRM), the Department of State’s Bureau for Global Food Security, and/or any of their predecessor offices, within the past three (3) years is REQUIRED.

• Deep familiarity with delivery of US federal humanitarian assistance, disaster response, stabilization, and/or similar crisis-oriented programming is REQUIRED.

• Current existing relationships within Department of State and/or implementors of federal humanitarian assistance and disaster response awards overseas is REQUIRED.

• Demonstrated experience and nuanced insights into successfully navigating the federal procurement process and the dynamic contracting environment.

• Demonstrated track record of engagement with senior-level government officials, particularly at Department of State or in related foreign-policy-focused roles.

• Prior experience advising capture or proposal teams targeting State Department contracts.

• Discretion, professionalism, and a strong sense of integrity in facilitating client-facing interactions.

title: Senior Product Manager, Billing & Marketplaces
description:
ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Customers can purchase directly from ClickHouse or through the cloud marketplaces. Billing is how every ClickHouse product reaches customers and shows up in our financials. As we add new products and new ways to buy, we are investing in our billing platform to scale with them. As Senior Product Manager for Billing and Marketplaces, you will own a key area of that work and report to the Director of Product Management, Billing and Marketplaces.

YOU WILL:

- Own the roadmap, execution, and launches for a key area of billing or marketplaces (for example metering and pricing, prepaid commit, or a cloud marketplace), working alongside engineering leads, Finance, and Sales Ops.

- Scope features with engineering, turn them into a clear near-term roadmap, and track them through to launch.

- Improve our prepaid commit capabilities, including customer-specific rate cards, contract changes and rollovers, customer-facing balance visibility, and spend alerts.

- Drive our cloud marketplace integrations across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including private offers, usage reporting, and subscription linking.

- Improve payment and collections flows, including dunning and delinquency handling, so customers are billed accurately and service is not interrupted by avoidable billing issues.

- Lead billing launches for new products and pricing models in partnership with Product Marketing, Sales, and Support.

- Serve as a subject matter expert on how customers are billed across the company.

YOU BRING:

- 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning billing, metering, payments, or commercial platforms for a cloud or usage-based product.

- Solid understanding of usage-based pricing, prepaid credits, and committed spend contracts, and how they translate into systems, invoices, and revenue.

- Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure marketplaces, including private offers, co-sell, and metering APIs.

- Familiarity with payments across card, invoice, and marketplace channels, including dunning and delinquency flows.

- Working knowledge of order-to-cash, including invoicing, tax, multi-currency, and revenue recognition.

- Experience with third-party billing and payment platforms, such as Stripe or a usage-based billing vendor.

- A track record of independently leading complex projects across engineering, Finance, and go-to-market teams, from scoping through launch.

- Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting trade-offs to product and engineering leadership and explaining billing concepts to non-technical audiences.

BONUS POINTS:

- Experience at an infrastructure, database, or developer platform company.

- Comfortable going deep with engineers on event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and idempotency, and fluent enough in SQL to analyze billing data yourself.

Storyous pomáhá lokálním podnikům řídit jejich každodenní provoz. K tomu potřebujeme rozvíjet kvalitní spolupráci s technologickými, obchodními a oborovými partnery a zároveň zajistit, aby naše integrace přinášely skutečnou hodnotu zákazníkům i společnosti.
Hledáme člověka, který převezme plnou odpovědnost za dvě propojené oblasti:

• Integrations: řízení a rozvoj integračního portfolia, spolupráce s technologickými partnery a vedení nových integračních iniciativ od nápadu až po stabilní provoz.

• Partnerships: vyhledávání, vyjednávání a rozvoj partnerství, která pomohou Storyous oslovit více relevantních zákazníků a rozšířit hodnotu našeho produktu.

Nejde o roli, ve které člověk pouze předává požadavky dál. Budeš vlastníkem výsledku: pochopíš obchodní příležitost, vyhodnotíš její potenciál, navrhneš model spolupráce, vyjednáš podmínky, zajistíš realizaci, prosadíš potřebné změny napříč firmou a následně změříš, zda iniciativa přináší očekávanou hodnotu.
Tvoje mise
Vybudovat a řídit portfolio integrací a partnerství, které:

• zvyšuje hodnotu Storyous pro zákazníky;

• podporuje růst obchodních výsledků a akvizici nových zákazníků;

• vytváří nové distribuční a obchodní příležitosti;

• zlepšuje produktovou nabídku a uživatelskou zkušenost;

• Zmapuješ jejich obchodní účel, technický a provozní stav, zapojené týmy, náklady, přínosy a největší rizika.

• Společně s Product, Engineering a Operations budeš hledat možnosti standardizace, automatizace a zjednodušení podpory.

2. Vyhledávání a rozvoj partnerství

• Povedeš celý proces od identifikace a kvalifikace partnera přes návrh spolupráce a vyjednávání až po onboarding, launch a další rozvoj.

• Navrhneš vhodný model spolupráce podle konkrétní příležitosti - například referral, reseller, co-selling, společná nabídka nebo strategická spolupráce.

description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.
The Role
As an Electrical Engineer, you will own the design, integration, and bring-up of the electronic systems that power Asimov. From power distribution to motor control to sensor integration, you will work across schematics, PCB layouts, harness design, and hardware debug -- ensuring every electrical decision holds up in the field and integrates cleanly with the broader mechanical and firmware stack.
What You'll Do

• Design and review schematics and PCB layouts for power distribution units, motor driver boards, and actuator control electronics

• Integrate wiring harnesses, PCBA enclosures, and motor controllers into mechanical assemblies from the ground up

• Lead bring-up of power systems, sensors, and actuator subassemblies; diagnose and resolve issues across multiple hardware revisions

• Define and run electrical and system-level test protocols, analyze failure modes, and iterate based on test data

• Work closely with firmware and controls teams to ensure electrical design choices support stable, low-latency control loops

• Apply expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression to ensure robust and field-reliable hardware

• Contribute to Menlo 's open-source design efforts, including PCB schematics and manufacturing documentation for the broader robotics community

What You'll Bring

• 3 or more years of hands-on electrical engineering experience on high-complexity electromechanical products

• Solid understanding of electrical and electronic systems, including motor drivers, sensors, and embedded hardware integration

• Deep familiarity with low-voltage (under 60V) DC power systems, DC-DC converters, MOSFET gate drivers, current-sense amplifiers, and passive network design

• Proficiency using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and CAN/UART sniffers for in-depth hardware debug

• Expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression techniques

• Strong communication skills to drive alignment across firmware teams, mechanical engineers, and leadership

Bonus points for:

• Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware or legged locomotion platforms

• Familiarity with CAN bus, motor controllers, and how electrical design choices affect firmware and control integration

• Scripting experience in Python for hardware automation and data analysis

• Familiarity with sim-to-real workflows and how hardware decisions affect locomotion policy training and transfer

Why Join Menlo ?
You will be part of a tight-knit team defining the next generation of humanoid robots. With genuine ownership of the mechanical systems that bring Asimov to life, you will see your designs go from CAD to real-world deployments. If you thrive in fast-paced, open-collaborative environments, let's build the future of robotics together.
A Note on AI
You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
Equal Opportunity and Accommodations
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we stil

description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

InterNetX is part of the IONOS Group SE and has been developing innovative solutions for domains, hosting, and encryption since 1998. As an Internet Service Provider with approximately 10 million managed domains, InterNetX is one of the top providers in the market. The heart of domain management is AutoDNS, supported by a distributed landscape of microservices, interfaces to registries, and specialized business systems operating in a 24/7 high-availability environment. • Develop and expand scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot (partly PHP) in the areas of domain, server, and certificate management, as well as integrate external APIs.

• Write unit and integration tests, review merge requests, and help shape CI/CD pipelines via GitLab and Kubernetes.

• Analyze errors using logs and databases and sustainably resolve root causes.

• Contribute to functional and technical enhancements (e.g., new regulatory requirements, billing, monitoring, and platform stability).

• Actively use and shape modern AI tools in daily workflows (e.g., AI coding assistants for refactoring, testing, code reviews, and custom AI agents).

• Currently enrolled in a degree program related to computer science (e.g., Computer Science, Business Informatics, Media Informatics) with the ability to work alongside your studies.

• Basic knowledge of Git and interest in working with GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.

• Structured, goal-oriented, and independent working style, strong team spirit, and good communication skills.

• Numerous training and development opportunities.

• Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

title: Gestionnaire, Finance et stratégie// Finance & Strategy Manager
description:
À propos du poste

À titre de gestionnaire, Finance et stratégie chez Hopper, vous serez un partenaire financier pour les leaders d'affaires de toute l'entreprise, en les aidant à comprendre la performance, à évaluer les occasions et à prendre de meilleures décisions. Vous construirez les modèles derrière nos prévisions, nos partenariats et nos plans stratégiques, dirigerez les revues d'affaires et transformerez l'analyse en recommandations claires pour la haute direction et le chef de la direction financière.

Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne qui a bâti des modèles rigoureux sous pression en banque d'investissement ou en capital-investissement et qui souhaite maintenant mettre ces compétences à profit à l'interne, plus près des décisions. Nous sommes une équipe agile qui avance rapidement, et nous utilisons SQL et des outils d'IA comme Claude pour automatiser le travail manuel afin de consacrer notre temps à l'analyse et à la stratégie.

À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien

- Construire et maintenir des modèles financiers intégrés, des analyses de scénarios et de sensibilité, ainsi que des analyses de rentabilisation pour de nouveaux produits, partenariats et investissements

- Évaluer les paramètres économiques des nouvelles ententes commerciales (tarification, partage des revenus, économie unitaire, RCI) et aider à façonner les modalités des ententes avec les leaders d'affaires

- Soutenir les décisions de financement, de fusions et acquisitions et de répartition du capital, y compris les modèles et les analyses qui les sous-tendent

- Être responsable des prévisions mensuelles et trimestrielles pour les secteurs que vous soutenez, et contribuer au budget annuel et au plan à long terme en construisant les modèles fondés sur les inducteurs qui relient les indicateurs opérationnels aux résultats financiers

- Diriger les revues mensuelles et trimestrielles des résultats réels par rapport au plan et aux prévisions, expliquer les écarts et signaler les risques et les occasions aux leaders d'affaires

- Collaborer avec la direction sur des questions à fort impact comme la taille des marchés, la priorisation des investissements et l'optimisation des coûts

- Préparer des documents clairs, adaptés à la haute direction, au conseil d'administration et aux investisseurs, qui racontent l'histoire derrière les chiffres

- Utiliser SQL, BigQuery et des outils d'IA pour automatiser les rapports et analyses récurrents afin que l'équipe consacre moins de temps à manipuler des données et plus de temps à en tirer des constats

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- 4 ans ou plus d'expérience en banque d'investissement, en développement corporatif, en capital-investissement, en finance stratégique ou en planification et analyse financières (FP&A). Une expérience en banque d'investissement ou en capital-investissement (analyste ou associé(e)) est privilégiée

- Des compétences avancées en modélisation financière : modèles à trois états financiers, flux de trésorerie actualisés (DCF), analyses de scénarios et de sensibilité. Expertise dans Excel / Google Sheets

- Une solide compréhension de la comptabilité et des liens entre les trois états financiers

- D'excellentes aptitudes en communication, avec la capacité d'expliquer des concepts financiers à des partenaires non financiers et de présenter avec assurance à la haute direction

- Une connaissance pratique de SQL, ou une capacité démontrée à maîtriser rapidement des outils techniques

- Une utilisation concrète d'outils d'IA (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) pour travailler plus rapidement et automatiser les tâches répétitives

- Un grand sens des responsabilités, une aisance avec l'ambiguïté et un état d'esprit de bâtisseur. Hopper avance rapidement

- Un diplôme en finance, en économie, en administration, en mathématiques, en génie ou dans une autre discipline quantitative

Atouts

- Une expérience en technologie, en fintech, en voyage, en places de marché ou en partenariat

title: Software Engineer, Web (Growth)
description:
We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, owning the user-facing web at amo. For many people, the web is where they first meet our apps: a link shared by a friend, opened in a messenger or a social feed, often seconds before they decide whether to download. That moment matters a lot to us.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team on the surfaces that bring new people into our products, gradually taking ownership of a growing part of our consumer web experience. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable working across product, engineering and growth.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member.

AS A WEB ENGINEER, YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL INCLUDE:

CONSUMER WEB EXPERIENCES

Building fast, beautiful, conversion-focused web experiences that show off our apps at their best, from the first link someone taps to the moment they open the app. You’ll turn designs into polished UI that loads instantly on any device and in any in-app browser, and you’ll care about every millisecond and every pixel.

DEEP LINKING & APP ENTRY

Owning the bridge between web and app: Universal Links, App Links, deferred deep linking, attribution, and App Clips. Whether the user already has the app or not, every link should take them exactly where they expect to go.

SHARING & RICH PREVIEWS

Making everything shared from our apps look great everywhere it lands. That includes generating dynamic OG metadata and preview images at scale, and iterating on what gets shared and how it’s presented, based on what actually converts.

ANALYTICS & EXPERIMENTATION

Designing and maintaining our event tracking taxonomy (Amplitude) so that the data is consistent, well organized and trusted across teams. You’ll instrument funnels end-to-end, run rigorous A/B tests, and turn the results into decisions.

GROWTH INITIATIVES

Identifying and shipping new ways to improve acquisition and conversion. We expect you to look at the funnel, form your own hypotheses, build, measure, and then either scale or drop the idea. You’ll be an active contributor to the roadmap, not just its executor.

OWNING YOUR SCOPE

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.

YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

We are hiring multiple engineers of varying levels, so please indicate your years of experience on the application form to apply for the appropriate position.

5+ years of professional experience building consumer-facing web products.

Deep expertise in React / Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js.

Strong understanding of web performance: rendering strategies (SSR, edge, static), caching, CDNs, Core Web Vitals, and how mobile and in-app browsers behave.

Hands-on experience with deep linking, Universal Links / App Links and attribution. Experience with App Clips is a big plus.

Experience designing analytics taxonomies and running experiments, and real care for data quality.

A growth mindset: you think in funnels and conversion rates, and you love moving a metric.

Strong product and visual taste. You notice the 2px misalignment and the 100ms delay.

Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend. Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus.

Passion and experience building consumer-facing products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped!

AI is part of how we build every day. We’re looking for engineers with a real grasp of these tools, who use them to multiply their output and not to make up for missing expertise. title: Project Control Analyst (Senior)
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Project Control Analyst to provide financial analysis, project controls, reporting, and contract-administration support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role manages and analyzes funding, invoicing, expenditures, burn rates, estimates at completion, spend plans, tools, travel, other direct costs, and related contract-financial data.
The Senior Project Control Analyst will support SAM.gov service-contract reporting, monitor funding and expenditures by Contract Line Item Number, develop financial information for Monthly Status Reports and Program Management Reviews, and maintain accurate data for program dashboards and approval workflows. This position will work closely with program leadership, contracts, finance, task leads, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders to promote accurate forecasting, compliant invoicing, and timely financial decision-making.
This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.
Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Senior Project Control Analyst will:

• Prepare and maintain annual service-contract labor reporting data for submission through SAM.gov, including applicable subcontractor labor.

• Monitor task order funding, expenditures, commitments, and available balances by CLIN, contract period, task, and cost category.

• Develop and maintain budget-versus-actual analyses, burn-rate calculations, forecasts, and estimates at completion.

• Prepare spend plans, funding-status reports, financial dashboards, and other decision-support products for program leadership.

• Develop financial inputs for Monthly Status Reports, Program Management Reviews, Project Management Plan updates, and other recurring program deliverables.

• Track planned and actual expenditures and identify funding, schedule, or performance variances requiring management attention.

• Prepare draft invoice backup documentation and reconcile supporting data before submission for Government review and approval.

• Validate invoice charges against the applicable contract period, CLIN, labor category, rate, quantity, and supporting documentation.

• Support electronic invoice preparation and submission through the Government-designated invoicing system.

• Track current-period and cumulative invoicing, subcontracted amounts, billed costs, remaining balances, and final-invoice status.

• Maintain detailed tracking for tools, travel, and other direct costs, including purchase documentation, approvals, incurred costs, and cumulative amounts invoiced.

• Support Requests to Initiate Purchase, Consent to Purchase requests, and Travel Authorization Requests.

• Track whether proposed purchases are commercial or non-commercial items or services and maintain supporting commerciality records.

• Coordinate with contracts, accounting, finance, procurement, task leads, and subcontractors to validate financial data and resolve discrepancies.

• Maintain financial data supporting Task Order Management Portal dashboards, management reports, and approval workflows.

• Establish and maintain consistent financial-control procedures, templates, logs, and reconciliation processes.

• Support funding and financial-data transitions during transition-in and transition-out activities.

• Analyze financial trends and communicate potential funding shortfalls, overruns, underruns, invoicing delays, and other risks to program leadership.

• Maintain organized, complete, and auditable financial records in accordance with contract and company requirements.

• Protect sensitive Government, corporate, personnel, and financial information.

Required Qualifications

• Active Secret clearance or higher.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

• Minimum of 8 years of relevant prof

title: Head of Consumer and Lending Compliance
description:
About the Company
Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all - bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.
The Department: Compliance
Compliance at Gemini is a team dedicated to managing the next generation of financial crime prevention in a complex and evolving regulatory environment. We are a diverse group of technology, legal, and operational professionals who develop new approaches to solving classic problems using cutting edge tools and processes.
The Role: Head of Consumer and Lending Compliance
In this role,you will lead the compliance program for Gemini ’s deposit and lending products, including the first-in-class crypto rewards credit card and business credit card. title: CSO West (AZ, CA, CO, ID, MT, NM, NV, OR, UT, WA, WY)
description:
Is your love for leading a company based on the market dynamics coming into conflict with the realization that you are tired of working full time for one company? Would you love the idea of hands on working as part of the management team of 2 or 3 companies at once, supported by 125 other world class fractional executives? If you have held the position of VP of Sales or CSO at one or more Operating Companies for 10 or more years, but don’t want to go back and do it again, you may be a fit for what we do. Chief Outsiders , , is a national company that is growing very quickly and is looking to add CSOs in multiple US markets.
What We Do: Our focus is on helping midsize companies with the leadership they need for major initiatives in strategy, marketing, and sales management to drive top-line growth long after we are gone. We are specifically looking for qualified sales executives who would love the opportunity to work for two or three companies at once.
What We Look For: We want sales executives who can help a CEO or business owner understand where and how to grow and then apply the tools needed to take sales to the next level. If you have a minimum of 10 years’ experience in multiple VP of Sales roles reporting to the CEO then please apply.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

Every day, Confido processes remittances, deductions, retailer disputes, and trade spend for some of the fastest-growing brands in CPG. When our platform is down or slow, a customer’s cash gets stuck. We’re hiring a DevOps Engineer to own the infrastructure and tooling that keeps the platform fast, safe, and easy to ship to.

You’ll work across AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, observability, and security. Your goal is to make it easier for every engineer at Confido to ship confidently, debug quickly, and operate production without heroics. This is a hands-on role. You’ll split your time between planned platform projects and whatever production needs today. You’ll work closely with our product engineers and engineering leadership. We expect you to form your own opinions about where the platform needs to go and then make it happen.

Location: New York, NY (in office; relocation supported)

What You’ll Do

- Own and improve our production infrastructure on AWS, including Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, S3, networking, IAM, and load balancing.

- Manage infrastructure as code in Terraform so that every change is reviewable, repeatable, and safe to roll back.

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for our Rails, Python, and TypeScript services, including migrations and automated testing.

- Expand observability across services with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana, so issues surface before customers notice them.

- Investigate production incidents, find root causes, and ship lasting fixes instead of manual workarounds.

- Make deployments safer with automated checks, progressive rollouts, and clear rollback paths.

- Partner with product engineers on local development, test environments, and release workflows.

- Track capacity, reliability, and cloud spend, and make practical improvements as customer volume grows.

- Help define our incident response, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.

- Join a shared on-call rotation, and make on-call better for everyone on it.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: You’ll learn our architecture, deployment process, and security controls. You’ll ship changes through the existing pipeline. You’ll review recent incidents and recurring pain points, and start knocking some of them out.

By 60 days: You’ll own a meaningful area, such as CI/CD, observability, deployment reliability, or cloud security. You’ll also deliver improvements that cut manual work or make releases faster and safer.

By 90 days: You’ll land a significant platform improvement with measurable results, such as faster deploys, fewer incidents, better recovery time, stronger security, or lower cloud cost. You’ll also have a prioritized infrastructure roadmap, and you’ll be the person the team trusts on production and platform decisions.

What We’re Looking For

Required

- 3+ Years of experience building and operating production infrastructure for a software product

- Strong AWS experience, including a working understanding of networking, compute, storage, databases, and IAM

- Experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes

- Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar)

- Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

title: VP of Software Engineering
description:
ABOUT NOOKS

Nooks is pioneering Classified-Infrastructure-as-a-Service (CIaaS) - designing, building, and operating Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and other secured, classified environments for the defense and national security community. We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We’re growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.

About the Role
You will lead software engineering at Nooks and own the technical vision for everything we build. That covers three things: the software we deliver under government contract, the platform our site teams and internal functions run on, and the AI strategy that shapes both. AI is not a side initiative here. It is in the products that win us contracts, and Nooks intends to be an industry leader in how we leverage modern AI. You will report to the CEO, sit on the executive leadership team, and set direction rather than receive it. You will be building the function while running it. The team is small today, the operating model is yours to define, and the plan for how it scales is a deliverable rather than a given. Priorities will shift as contracts land and as the business grows into new sites and new lines. You will need to hold a durable technical direction while making short-term calls with incomplete information, and you will be expected to bring answers instead of waiting for them.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering Organization and Delivery

• Lead, develop, and scale a software engineering organization accountable for delivery, quality, security, reliability, and operational outcomes based on internal and external customers

• Define the operating model that moves the team from project-based execution to outcome-based ownership, with clear intake, prioritization, and delivery cadence.

• Build a strong team through deliberate hiring, training, and retention, developing the engineers you have while adding the capabilities you need.

• Establish engineering metrics and reporting that give the executive team real visibility into velocity, quality, AI adoption, and business impact.

AI Strategy and Adoption

• Own the AI strategy across Nooks , spanning the AI capabilities in our delivered products and the integration of AI into how the company works.

• Drive measurable AI adoption across internal functions, accountable not just for shipping capability but for changing how teams actually operate.

• Rebuild how Nooks captures, structures, and retrieves institutional knowledge so expertise scales beyond the people who hold it.

• Own AI governance for the software portfolio, including data handling, model use, and evaluation, coordinating with IT/Cyber where network security apply.

Government Contract Delivery and Capture

• Own delivery against awarded software contracts, including scope, schedule, technical quality, and customer confidence in our capabilities.

• Run awarded work as a managed line with visible economics, owning cost, staffing, and utilization against the commitment (and EBITA expectations).

• Represent Nooks engineering and AI capability directly to government customers, in delivery reviews and in pursuit conversations.

• Support Growth on software pursuits by shaping technical approach, staffing models, and cost inputs, and by converting delivered work into past performance Nooks can compete on.

Internal Technology Strategy, Platform, and Investment

• Set the technology strategy and architecture roadmap for everything the team builds, including systems that may deploy into customer environments.

• Own the platform our site teams, Operations, and internal functions depend on to manage our spaces, our members, and our customer contracts.

• Make and defend build-versus-buy decisions, integrating commercial systems where they fit
